records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Noticed Orchard Collective hasn't gotten a project going in Wrenfield yet. If something got in the way, happy to help clear it -- even a 10-minute call can usually unstick it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Noticed you invited someone to the team. Hope the handoff's been smooth -- anything I can help with?

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Collective
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Orchard Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project and no key milestone; stall_reasons list both. One invite sent ([email:0666b3e1]) shows mild engagement, but Victor never replied to either outreach ([email:8bd81c62], [email:0666b3e1]) and filed no tickets. Pro plan suggests intent, so some self-serve chance in 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

I saw you got a teammate invited — nice first step. The natural next one is creating your first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so once one exists the rest has somewhere to go. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow it.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and your teammate so it reflects how your team actually works.

Best,
Chidi
